about: The falsifier: at 306 accept signed every line of its batches with the one key it was given and refused any line a lane had signed (BARE), so a cycle of lanes landed one accept per lane, each re-folding every place and running every gate, and two lanes' lines that forked each other landed as a fork unless one signer forked itself.

cases.answer: REFUSE·bare: a batch proposes by=target, and accept signs
